caseName: Standard Cigar Co. v. Tabacalera Severiano Jorge, S. A.
caseNameFull: Standard Cigar Co. v. Tabacalera Severiano Jorge, S. A.
attorneys: William, A. Gillen for petitioner., Thomas H. Anderson and Herbert L. Nadeau for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit for further consideration in light of Banco Nacional de Cuba v. Sabbatino, ante, p. 398.
